new_candidates.title: Sunrise between the towers
new_candidates.role: Replacement for rejected L02; optional second view
new_candidates.author: mhx (Marcus Holland-Moritz)
new_candidates.visual: The sun sits between the complete towers, with a warm reflection across the Thames and textured clouds above. This is a brighter, more dramatic alternative to the rejected purple-blue dusk image.
new_candidates.caution: The colour and contrast are pronounced, not understated. L01 remains the selected London lead. This candidate would be a second gallery view only; it is not approved merely because L01 is approved.
new_candidates.alt: Tower Bridge at sunrise, with sunlight between the towers reflected in the River Thames.
new_candidates.source_reference: Wikimedia Commons, original photographer on Flickr

new_candidates.title: The palace beyond spring flowers
new_candidates.author: DAVID ILIFF
new_candidates.visual: The eastern façade and Victoria Memorial are visible together, with red and yellow flowers creating an ordered foreground. A clear daylight counterpart to the evening photographs already approved.
new_candidates.caution: Small pedestrians, street fittings and a vehicle remain in the middle distance. This is a seasonal archival view, not a promise of present-day planting or access to the palace gardens. Retain the photographer’s credit and licence link near the image.
new_candidates.alt: Buckingham Palace and the Victoria Memorial behind beds of red and yellow spring flowers.

new_candidates.title: Muted colour and townhouse detail
new_candidates.author: Matt Pictures (@photographybymat_26)
new_candidates.visual: A diagonal row of blue-grey, lavender and white façades, with white window trim and iron railings. No cars or people obstruct the buildings in the inspected photograph.
new_candidates.caution: This is a restrained neighbourhood detail, not a grand street panorama. The lower steps are partially cropped. The source explicitly identifies Notting Hill; the exact original pixel dimensions still need verification during download.
new_candidates.alt: Pastel blue, lavender and white terraced houses with iron railings in Notting Hill, London.
new_candidates.source_reference: Photographer’s Unsplash page; original download preview inspected

new_candidates.title: Glass roof, ironwork and warm lanterns
new_candidates.author: Henry Kellner
new_candidates.visual: Repeated green arches and hanging lanterns create a strong central perspective beneath the glass roof. The architecture reads clearly, with more depth and balance than a crowded storefront close-up.
new_candidates.caution: Visitors and diners are visible below and along the sides. This is not a people-free photograph, and the archival shop signs must not be presented as a current retailer list. Keep the roof’s symmetry and the central vanishing point in the final crop.
new_candidates.alt: Covent Garden Market’s glass roof, green iron arches and lanterns above the galleries and dining area.

new_candidates.destination: Kent and the White Cliffs of Dover
new_candidates.title: Chalk cliffs in warm coastal light
new_candidates.author: kallerna
new_candidates.visual: A sunlit chalk face curves towards calm blue water, balanced by the darker foreground cliff. The view concentrates on the coastline rather than the port or a distant strip of white.
new_candidates.caution: The source identifies Dover in Kent, not Seven Sisters. Preserve its near-square proportions rather than cutting away the cliff face for a shallow banner. Small foreground branches remain; the image does not imply access to the photographed viewpoint.
new_candidates.alt: Sunlit White Cliffs of Dover above calm blue water, with a shaded chalk cliff in the foreground.

new_candidates.title: The south façade across the lawn
new_candidates.author: DeFacto
new_candidates.visual: Honey-coloured stone, the columned frontage and roofline are visible above an open lawn. The composition keeps the palace dominant without the event structures seen in other candidates.
new_candidates.caution: Small distant figures and a parasol remain at the edges. This is an archival exterior view, not a statement about present-day exhibitions or admission. U04 Cambridge remains the intended Beyond London lead; this adds a distinct estate setting.
new_candidates.alt: The south façade of Blenheim Palace above its lawn beneath a blue sky with light clouds.

unresolved_destinations.reason: The additional freely licensed images inspected were dominated by crowds, deep shadow, a car park or a distant approach. None was strong enough for this revised shortlist. No official marketing photograph has been assumed free to reuse.
